messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: hosted-api us-east queue growth. queue_length=42,300, p95 latency=12.4s, p99=29.1s. GPU provisioner failing with repeated 429 from cloud API. tagging #oncall and #eng-infra
Alex (oncall): ACK. jumping in. taking ownership. collecting logs + checking autoscaler status. what was the last deploy?
Irina - infra: No recent deploys. provisioner logs show throttled calls to cloud-create-instance: 429 rate_limit and 500 intermittents. provisioner retry loop exhausted -> failed leases.
Matt SRE: This smells like provider-side quota/soft-limit hit rather than our runtime. Can we enable fallback routing to dedicated pools + drop low-priority traffic?
Alex (oncall): Good call. Planning: 1) enable queue-scrubber (drop non-urgent / free-tier requests) 2) route traffic to dedicated-reserve for existing tenant-affinities 3) bump provisioner backoff.
Emily (runtime): I can flip scrubber in the control plane quickly. scrubber will evict requests with header "x-priority: low" and apply 1s retry window. Patch for provisioner backoff is tiny, I'll ship after scrubber is live.
Alex (oncall): Running scrubber toggle now.
Alex (oncall): ```
# enable scrubber for hosted queues (temporary)
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/queues/us-east/scrubber" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"enabled":true,"drop_policy":"low-priority-first","max_evict_per_min":10000}'
```
IncidentBot: ACTION: scrubber toggle accepted, job_id=jb-97421, starting eviction workers.
Irina - infra: Also applied a safety throttle rule: limit non-verified customers to 50r/s per shard to stabilize KV cache pressure.
Joe (cust-success): We're getting reports of 504s from a handful of mid-tier customers starting 17:12 UTC. I'm putting a short notice to the affected accounts and flagging for SLAs.
Matt SRE: Monitoring dashboard shows queue_length -> 28,700 after scrubber + throttle. p95 dropping to ~4.6s. p99 still elevated but trending down. Provisioner still hitting 429s on attempt to create new GPU nodes.
Emily (runtime): Rolling tiny provisioner backoff patch now to reduce request churn to cloud API (exponential backoff: 1s -> 2s -> 6s -> 18s). pushing canary.
Alex (oncall): Can we try a soft-failover to a cold dedicated pool? we have spare reserved capacity in us-east-dedicated-2 (100 GPUs) but need to flip routing for tenant-affinity.
Irina - infra: I'm authorizing a temporary route for service-tier=enterprise to us-east-dedicated-2. small script run.
Irina - infra: ```
# route enterprise tenants to dedicated pool
POST /internal/routing/redirect
{
  "selector": "service_tier=enterprise",
  "target_pool": "us-east-dedicated-2",
  "ttl": 900
}
```
IncidentBot: ROUTE APPLIED: enterprise -> us-east-dedicated-2 (ttl=900s).
Matt SRE: After route and scrubber, queue_length=6,900, p95=1.9s, p99=6.8s. Errors from provisioner reduced. Good sign.
Joe (cust-success): customers contacted, some subscribed to status RSS. Affected customers thanked for the quick update. No major SLA breaches logged yet, still monitoring.
Alex (oncall): Excellent. I'm marking incident as "mitigated" for paging rotation. Will continue monitoring for 30m. Irina, can you take primary for the follow-up? I'll hand off the rest of the timeline and notes.
Irina - infra: Taking it. I'll own the post-incident: root-cause investigation (cloud quota exhaustion vs our concurrency patterns), verify provisioner backoff rollout, and prepare a communication summary for customers.
Alex (oncall): Handoff complete :white_check_mark:. Key items for follow-up: - evaluate rate-limit/backoff changes - consider pre-warming DPX pool at traffic spikes - add autoscaler jitter to avoid synchronized retries - add explicit queue-scrubber runbook + KB article.
Matt SRE: Also recommend an alert to detect provisioner 429 spike rate (>=5/min sustained) and auto-enable scrubber sooner.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT MITIGATION NOTE: queue decreased to 2,300, p95=0.9s, p99=2.4s. incident state -> mitigated. recording timeline and linking logs: https://internal/logs/incident/1700700888
Irina - infra: Copy. I'll open a follow-up ticket, assign to infra + runtime, and schedule a postmortem. handing off to daytime team.
Alex (oncall): Thanks all. Passing paging baton to Irina and Matt for root cause. :hands:
